maddeler.e: يَهُودِيّ • (yahūdiyy) (feminine يَهُودِيَّة (yahūdiyya), masculine plural يَهُود (yahūd) or يَهُودِيُّون (yahūdiyyūn), feminine plural يَهُودِيَّات (yahūdiyyāt))
maddeler.t: Borrowed from Aramaic יְהוּדָיֵא (yəhūḏāyā). The borrowing happened at multiple times; from some Aramaic dialect with reduced onset one got هُود (hūd) (no singulative).
